subject: Battlefield
text: If you fight the first nine battles in a battle field, lower your exp. points to about 1-100 elsewhere, and defeat the last battle where you don't win anything, you'll get two level ups instead of one.

evidence.quote:
When you fight in a battle field, fight the first nine battles and leave one.
Go somewhere besides a battle field (for instance, the Bone Dungeon) and get to
where your exp. points are very, very low.ÊAbout 1-100. Go to a battle field
where you don't win anything and defeat the last battle.Ê You'll get two level
ups instead of one.

subject: Life spell
text: To get a full heal, use the Life spell in and out of battle to pump hp's back up.

evidence.quote:
To get a full heal, just use the Life spell. This
works IN and OUT of battle, so when you find a boss that has a special attack
that can mutilate your party in a few hits, use a Life spell to pump hp's back
up.

subject: Phobe
text: When Phobe joins press A 3 times to get her to join as a 680 hp character.

evidence.quote: When Phobe joins press A 3 times to get her to join as a 680 hp character.

subject: Dragon Claw
text: Tristan will give you the dragon claw if you spend time trying to get $9000.

evidence.quote:
Normally you're not expected to have the amount of money Tristan wants for the
dragon claw when he gets it and offers to sell it. If you want to spend time
trying to get $9000, though, he'll give it to you.

subject: Treasure box
text: A treasure box carrying potions at the first forest, or any treasure box with a healing item, will be full again when you leave and go back.

evidence.quote:
At the beginning of the game, at the first forest, there is a treasure box
carrying potions. Take the potions and leave the forest. Now go back to the
forest and the treasure box will be full of potions again!...NOTE: You can do this in any town, forest, dungeon, etc. that has a treasure
box with any kind of healing item in it.

subject: Heal Spell
text: Using the Heal Spell from Falls Basin on an enemy could put them to sleep, paralyze them, poisen them, confuse them, and petrify them.

evidence.quote:
Once you get your Heal Spell,( Falls Basin ) you can really hurt an enemy. If
you use your Heal Spell on an enemy, it could put them to sleep, paralyze them,
poisen them, confuse them, and petrify them!!

subject: Life Spell
text: The Life Spell kills almost everybody unless they are strong against fatal attacks, and the Exit Spell kills everybody except the bosses.

evidence.quote:
Well, the Life Spell
kills almost everybody unless they are strong against fatal attacks. The Exit
Spell kills everybody except the bosses.

subject: Battlefield
text: You can go to a battlefield, fight a couple times, leave, and go back to clear it out when you need more power.

evidence.quote:
In the game, go to a battlefield and fight a couple times. Then leave for
something else. When you get to a part of the game where you need more power,
go back to the battlefields and clear it out.
